dbl.text: Eiko Shizuki shares a mochi with her brother Kaito in the sparring room, and then Light-Paws announces that they will no longer be sparring partners because Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.

She invites Kaito into her apartment by leaving the window open, explains that Risona's supporters grow bolder as the throne stays empty, and tells him that Tameshi was seen meeting a man with a metal arm in the Undercity.
Later she encourages the Wanderer to save Kaito from the ambush, and her dagger strikes Tezzeret on the rooftops.
When Light-Paws grows a new tail, Eiko and Kaito bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa, and Kaito says goodbye to her before leaving to find Tamiyo.
